profile.headline: Software Engineer / Data Scientist / Computer Nerd
profile.summary: I am a lifelong learner who takes great joy in being able to quickly grasp and implement new technical concepts while bringing a sense of whimsy and humor to the workplace. As an accomplished Python developer with 5 years of experience, I analyze complex data to solve business problems and provide time/cost savings by designing informative dashboards and streamlining and automating ETL processes.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Developed Natural Language Processing (NLP) workflows for a variety of use cases including document modeling, content comparison, and sentiment analysis
• Built and published multiple internal code packages to automate repetitive operations to assist other team members
• Designed and deployed intuitive and interactive data-driven dashboards for various risk assessments and mitigation systems with tech stacks built using Dash & Plotly for Python, PostgreSQL, and in-house APIs

Selected Project Experience:
• Contract to Analyze NSA Meeting Data
	o Developed Python code to parse a corpus of more than a terabyte of data containing 20+ years of meeting minutes, documents, and technical reports
	o Identified trends in collaboration, disagreement, and discussion topics over time and created compelling charts of evidence-based findings
• Automated Aircraft Test Tracking
	o Led a team in replacing the customer’s manually created excel spreadsheets used for tracking aircraft subsystem testing progress with a custom Flask dashboard where users could upload their documents and view relevant statistics resulting in efficiency improvements over 10x
	o Developed data processing pipelines that extracted, cleaned, and organized tabular information from thousand-page-long PDFs into a self-designed SQLite database
	o Automated the creation of additional test status visualizations that provided holistic views of which test criteria still needed to be completed
• Graph Modeling of Research Papers
	o Developed a wrapper for the IEEE Xplore® API to allow for fast querying and filtering of research paper metadata
	o Automated the creation of network models which highlight author interactions across different areas of study and allow stakeholders to easily find interesting connections among thousands of papers, as opposed to manually searching the web database

positions.title: Controls Engineer
positions.description:
• Used AutoCAD Electrical to create electrical schematics for industrial control panels and
accompanying field device layouts for warehouse conveyor systems
• Traveled to Amazon and other customer warehouses to deploy automation solutions,
including programming Allen-Bradley PLCs to control conveyor systems using ladder logic

positions.title: Summer Research Student
positions.description:
• Worked with graduate students to design and construct a complete system, including
hardware and software, for an interface to allow a human to control a robotic arm with their
foot
• Wrote a Java application to use readings from a six-axis force-torque sensor to control a
cursor in a virtual reaching game

honors.title: Booz Allen Hamilton Values in Practice Award
honors.description: Demonstrated "Unflinching Courage" during times of team conflict
